content:
Although Claude using computers on desktop machines isn't new, the ability to run tasks in the background is indeed a welcome upgrade.

Anthropic announced today that the background computer use feature is now available for Claude Code, currently supporting only the macOS platform, and accessible to Pro and Max subscribers.

OpenAI previously integrated Codex into ChatGPT and was the first to bring background computer use functionality to Mac. It's pleasing to see Claude's Mac application continually improving its version.

When using AI-driven computer use features, having to hand over mouse control to the agent significantly diminishes their usefulness. But when it can run in the background, it becomes a major multitasking breakthrough on Mac.

Learn more about Claude's computer use feature, available for Code and Cowork.

Unleash the full potential of your Apple products
